note: Pure_WSLS has no sensory coordinate (no w/s0/kappa), so only M0's own ell_short/ell_long columns are reused here, unchanged, by start_id -- exactly the same eight rows M1_stimulus_kernel_v1 and m1_hmm_true_v1 extend with their own single added parameter. This is the same deliberate eight-point joint design M0 itself uses for multi-start coverage, not a controlled one-parameter-at-a-time identifiability sweep (see M0's own initialization table note). Since alpha is fixed at exactly 1.0 (not fitted) and there is no sensory coordinate, fitting two parameters by L-BFGS is extremely cheap: every start is run sequentially in one process rather than dispatched across a process pool.

starts.purpose: Short-category lapse with near-zero long lapse
